name: rag
description: Retrieval-style query: a reference passage is provided in-prompt and must be used to answer. Stresses prompt processing over long input with grounded generation.

workload.prompt:
Context: Local AI inference runs entirely on user hardware. Tokens are generated sequentially; each token depends on all previous ones, so generation speed (tok/s) dominates perceived latency for long answers while time-to-first-token (TTFT) dominates perceived snappiness. Quantization trades model precision for memory footprint; q4_K_M is a common quality/speed compromise. Power draw matters on laptops where sustained thermals throttle performance.

Question: Based only on the context above, explain in three sentences why a system can feel fast on short replies yet slow on long ones, and which two metrics distinguish those cases.
